description: PAC-MAN Championship Edition DX+, an official follow-up to the original PAC-MAN game that took the world by storm back in the eighties, is now available from Windows Store! This is a pumped-up version of the original PAC-MAN, with split-second turnarounds and big bonuses! Whether you're an experienced PAC-MAN player or a beginner, give this powered-up PAC-MAN a try!
